ValidationRule.description: This validation rule prevents users from manually selecting the Submitted status for Water Lab Test Requisition records. The Submitted status is reserved for the integration process. Users must select a different status to save the record.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Submitted"), ISBLANK(SubmittedDateTime__c), RecordType.DeveloperName = "PHOCSWaterLabTestRequisition", $Profile.Name <> "Salesforce API Only System Integrations", $Profile.Name <> "System Administrator" )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Enter a different value in the Status field. 'Submitted' is reserved for integration process only.
